Hachidori is [opinionated](https://github.com/bee-san/hachidori/blob/main/README.md#opinionated). Its creator mainly reads visual novels and manga. Contributions that add bloat without a personal benefit for the creator will be declined.

## Problem and change

Explain the problem and the resulting behavior. Link a related issue if there is one.

## Benefit to the creator

How does this change help the creator as a Japanese learner who mainly reads visual novels and manga? Give a concrete example. For fixes or documentation, explain how this improves the existing workflow.

## Scope and trade-offs

Why is this the smallest useful change? Describe any extra settings, dependencies, or maintenance, and why the benefit justifies that complexity.

## Validation

List the checks you ran and their exact outcomes. Explain any relevant checks you did not run. Include screenshots for visible UI changes and before-and-after measurements for changes that may affect runtime speed.

- [ ] I have read [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/bee-san/hachidori/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md).
- [ ] I understand that the creator may decline this PR if it does not benefit them personally.
